evidence:
solve.sh contract (quality-checks.md #19 / check-solve-contract.py): task/solution/solve.sh starts '#!/bin/bash', no CR byte anywhere in the frozen task (Python scan), 'bash -n' OK, sha256 1df2ed04...030a. It writes only under /app: 'mkdir -p /app' (line 3), 'cp -a "$(dirname "$0")/app/." /app/' (line 32), and 'rm -f -- "$database_path" ...' (line 33) where database_path is forced under /app (lines 5-9, exit 1 otherwise). Nothing written to /tests, /logs/verifier or /solution; no pkill, no NODE_ENV, no bare nproc, no pip/npm install. Beyond the template (mkdir + cp -a, a strict subset), an inline node /proc scan refuses reinstall while a process holds an existing DB; it exits 0 immediately when no DB exists (line 16), so a fresh Oracle install is unaffected, and a stale DB is deleted so installation is a fresh baseline.

Runtime contract (instruction.md lines 15-17): entry solution/app/server.js -> require('./src/index.js'); bootstrap.js:43 'server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0', ...)' honours PORT, default 3000; bootstrap.js:20-23 answers GET/HEAD /api/health 200 before and independent of the SQLite worker (health never touches the DB). UI and API come from one Node process (worker_thread on 127.0.0.1 ephemeral port proxied by the main thread; index.js:42-43 express.static(path.join(__dirname,'..','public')); index.js:439 SPA fallback) and are cwd-independent. db.js:9 'process.env.DB_PATH || path.join(__dirname, '..', 'app.db')' gives /app/app.db by default and honours DB_PATH; worker env copies process.env so DB_PATH/NODE_PATH reach it (bootstrap.js:45). Self-contained: seed read from beside the module (db.js:10 src/seed_data.json), byte-identical to environment/assets/seed_data.json (sha256 a1c65c80...3740 both); grep finds no /assets, /instructions, /tests, /logs or outbound server-side fetch. Seeding idempotent: db.js:62 returns when users already exist; seeding is one transaction; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS. No shipped *.db in solution/app. express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 match package.json and are preinstalled globally in environment/Dockerfile:9-12 and tests/Dockerfile:16-22 with NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules, which test.sh:106 also passes; no install at solve or run time.

Measured evidence (raw-evidence-index; I re-hashed all 8 indexed artifacts and all 12 matching_source_files against the frozen task: 0 mismatches): via-solve.sh runs 'bash /task/solution/solve.sh' into an empty /app, chowns to 65534, then workspace.cjs:16 launches 'node /app/server.js' with cwd /tmp and a cleared env (PATH, HOME, NODE_PATH, PORT=3000, DB_PATH) under setpriv uid 65534. results/via-solve.log: 'solve.sh installed: 11 files' (matches the 11 files under solution/app), then 26 PASS lines including 'restart keeps jobs, cards, order, messages, unread counts and activity without reseeding; live updates resume' and 'no JavaScript page errors'; server.log shows '[hireops] listening on 3000' twice (initial launch plus real restart).

Colderwater lessons bearing on this row: #19 (scripted golden harness: install with solve.sh, launch like test.sh, real restart) is satisfied by the above; #15 (real restart durability) observed without reseeding. #13/#25 public addresses: n/a, solve.sh and server use no network. Other lessons (brief voice, judge prompts, weights, timing) do not bear on row 19.

Adversarial probes: (a) conforming-reference failure modes: DB_PATH outside /app at solve time makes solve.sh exit 1, but neither the agent image nor Oracle sets DB_PATH for solve, and test.sh sets it only for the app launch; a non-root solve hitting EACCES in /proc would throw, but only when a DB already exists, never on a fresh install. (b) test.sh copy-fallback (APP_COPY=/tmp/submission when /app is not writable by 65534): the reference is location-independent (__dirname-relative public/ and seed, DB_PATH injected), so it also runs there. (c) a reference that silently depends on /assets at runtime is excluded: it reads its bundled copy.

Residual (not a defect, not a required measurement for this row): the scripted run used DB_PATH=/tmp/hireops-workspace.db rather than test.sh's /app/app.db and was not launched by test.sh itself; full configured verifier/Oracle runs are absent per the index scope. /app/app.db differs only in location inside a 65534-owned /app (test.sh:87, 99).
